SELECT ((r1.fastestLapSpeed - r2.fastestLapSpeed) / r1.fastestLapSpeed * 100) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT T1.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results AS T1
    JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
    WHERE T2.forename = 'Paul' AND T2.surname = 'di Resta' AND T1.raceId = 853
) AS r1,
(
    SELECT T1.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results AS T1
    JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
    WHERE T2.forename = 'Paul' AND T2.surname = 'di Resta' AND T1.raceId = 854
) AS r2
